It scored 4/11 on the broad-frame IV bridge: surface, block-AR, cross-cell correlation, and mean reversion passed; coverage, conditionality, time-series, cointegration, regime coverage, distributional fidelity, and pathwise jump realism failed. Metrics: cov90 49.0%, conditionality MAE reduction -2.4%, turb/calm ratio 0.973, daily KS 11/25, level KS 0/25, median-bias 1/25, persistent undercoverage 34.0%, cointegration gen/GT 0.426, mean-reversion ratio 0.920 with active corr 0.903.
next_step_recommendation: Run one encoded-coordinate temperature diagnostic to determine whether 622a is mostly a width failure or a path-location failure. If moderate widening cannot recover coverage/regime inclusion without breaking surface, mean reversion, and pathwise realism, close encoded preprocessing as a primary route and return to a stochastic path-law objective.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11.
